title: W01d: record-path preservation and claim round-trip integrity
description: Provide the helpers that keep every mutation writing to the exact file a record was loaded from, and close the unknown-field round-trip gap for claims. TaskRecord already round-trips unknown fields through its passthrough schema; ClaimRecord does not, and every claim is loaded and written through that schema, so a claim mutation drops unknown keys today. Fix the claim path, or make claim round-trips raw-preserving, so unknown claim fields survive a mutation.
acceptance: A claim record carrying an unknown field survives release, finish and a new transfer-style mutation unchanged.
A task record keeps writing back to the file it was loaded from even when the filename does not match its id, and an assumed filename is never used to create a second record.
Unknown fields on task records still survive every mutation that touches them.
Ledger validation passes and the schema change does not weaken existing required-field validation.
notes: Coordinate with the open task-record-unknown-fields task, which owns the TaskRecord decision; if that task also fixes ClaimRecord, land the change there instead of duplicating it. ClaimRecord is in src/core/schema.ts, loadClaims and claimFile in src/core/store.ts, releaseTask and finishTask in src/core/mutate.ts.
